'''Njarðvík FC''' ({{IPA|is|ˈnjarðˌviːk}}), commonly known as '''Njarðvík''' or '''UMFN''', is the men's football department of [[Ungmennafélag Njarðvíkur]] multi-sport club, based in the town of [[Reykjanesbær]] in Iceland. It currently plays in the [[Icelandic football league system]] second-tier [[1. deild karla (football)|1. deild karla]]."}}
